description: A cut, a gap, and a still held to the end. The sampled frames sit either side of every boundary: 29 is the last red frame and 30 the first black one, 44 the last black and 45 the first blue, 74 the last blue and 75 the first frame of the still. A cut landing one frame early or late, a gap that renders as anything but black, or a still that stops being held all fail here.
